You can do this by observing input output behavior, decompiling the program, or anything else. Your C program must not invoke ./mystery. Your C program must be fully independent and work even if I run it in complete isolation.
I’ll inspect the executable’s format, strings, and observable behavior, then implement and test a standalone C equivalent with the size constraint.
